nodes.label: .`text slot posts to chat completions with the bearer key and returns the answer text`()
.`vision slot sends the images as data urls next to the text and returns text`()
.`image slot asks for image output and returns decoded bytes with the media type`()
.`an image model answering with no image is a provider error and the loop moves on`()
.`a move-on error on A is answered by B and the next request starts from A again`()
.`a stalled model A times out and B answers`()
.`content refusal and invalid request stop without trying B`()
.`a 200 finished by the content filter is a content refusal and stops the loop`()
.`both models failing lists each attempt with its reason`()
.`an unparsable error body is classified by the status alone`()
.`an unparsable success body or a dropped connection is a provider error, never an exception`()
.`without a key nothing is called and the result is not-configured`()
.`the context boots without a key and exposes the adapter as the ModelProvider bean`()
